description: List the pieces in stock (text-only — no images, to keep the agent's context lean). Returns each product's handle, price (VAT included where applicable), and stage. Use get_product for one item's image. Prices are in the region's currency — pass `region` (an ISO-2 country) to price for a specific market, else the server default.

region.description: ISO-2 ship-to country to price for (e.g. se / us / de); overrides the server default

name: list_products
